title: 第一篇 入世 第三章 心障皆因嫉妒起 玉壶宗上仙人来第一篇 入世 第四章 资质测试堪称奇 吴昊入宗初别离
content_zh:
翌日清晨，袅袅炊烟从每家每户屋顶升起，主妇们都在灶台边为一家的早餐忙碌着，草草的结束简单的一餐，便又是卧溪村里的妇女们三三两两聚在在溪边洗衣的“围溪晨话”时间了。而每次的闲言碎语便免不了提及那五年前的事情，天天如此却又乐此不疲。
五年前，寒冬腊月，卧溪村。
冬日的乡村生活比以往的季节多了一分恬静。没有蝉鸣、没有播种、没有劳作、没有收割。如同往常一样，白日里孩子在雪地里嬉戏，大人在家里喂喂家禽叼叼烟袋。白天被寒冷压缩，太阳刚刚升起就迫不及待的坠下。
因为寒冷，家家户户皆是早早的进了被窝。也许是太阳刚刚藏起，也许是午夜时分，村民们不约而同的听到村子不远处的那片曾经是坟场的荒地上传来窸窸窣窣的声音。村民中迷信牛鬼蛇神者皆如鸵鸟一般，将脑袋捆扎在被子里，紧闭双眼，眼观鼻，鼻却透不过气，就这样放空了自己，不知到底是睡熟还是缺氧而昏厥。
有胆大者透过门窗的缝隙窥视，被寒冷遮掩的白色的村子里，唯独那片荒地处格外显眼的泛着粘稠的红光。空气中荡漾着甜腥的气味，也许是红光的味道，也许是紧张踢翻了尿桶。
而荒地处依稀可见几个黑色，也许是暗红的影子。步法如鬼魅一般，飘忽不定。而所到之处泥土涌动、树枝纷飞，待到一切归为平静的时候，这片荒地上竟然出现了一座房屋，而这些人影却仿佛凭空消失了一样。
第二天直到正午时分，村子里的鸡才稍稍的鸣了一声。家家户户便在这阳气最足的时辰纷纷抗着着锄头棍子壮着胆到荒地处一探究竟。荒地处凭空出现的房屋让村民们目瞪口呆。房屋四周的雪地平平整整，毫无践踏过的痕迹。
人们想近前观看详情，却发现屋门前插着一把黑漆漆的刀，更是没有人胆敢踏近一步，今天的胆气随着阳气的下降稍显不足便只能就此作罢，纷纷惊魂未定的退回了家。当晚这窸窸窣窣的声音却依然如此，次晚亦然。第三日又到了正午时分，家家户户壮着胆子出门探查，发现那房屋作了些许修缮，里面貌似添了一些琐碎之物。而雪地依然平整，黑刀依然竖立。这让卧溪村的村民惊心动魄，却又有莫名其妙。
某天夜里，那扰人心神的声音不见了，却换做了仿佛是猎猎风声，而透过门缝却观望到，那些黑影的速度变得极快，其间夹杂着一丝白色，仿佛有什么急事一般。而就在子丑交替之时，荒地处突然安静下来了，村民们紧张的屏气凝神，嫌自己的心跳声太过喧嚣。
而缓和了片刻，心情刚归于平静时，只听见窗外一声婴儿的啼哭，在这寒冬的夜里格外刺耳，仿佛整个世界里只剩下了这一种声音。
只是持续了半柱香的时间后，终是归于平静，而经历了情绪大起大跌的村民们却是难以入睡，蜷在被窝里，打着哆嗦，死死盯着窗外漆黑的夜色，皆感觉到黎明前的这段时间甚是煎熬。
天刚刚泛出鱼肚白，家家户户的人们似乎再也不想受这种煎熬之苦，有胆大者决定不管什么妖魔鬼怪都要去拼个鱼死网破，留下自家婆娘孩子便先后抄起家伙冲出家门，凶神恶煞张牙舞爪的咆哮着冲出门去，而片刻之后便突然没了声音，家人们的心全提到了嗓子眼。
一炷香的时间过去了，两柱香的时间过去了，有按耐不住的妇女拼也是的冲出门外，向那荒地之处奔去，却发现男人们竟是仿佛中了邪一般，纷纷丢下手中的工具，愣愣的围在那栋屋子旁。
那妇女拨开人群一看，那栋房屋门前竟站着一位妙龄少女，年方二十，柳眉澈目，皓齿星眸，肤若凝脂，着粉则太白，点朱则过赤，一身白衣胜雪，腰上挂着一个绛紫色香囊，乌黑的头发结成一个发髻上面斜插一个碧蓝色发簪，有些许碎发恰好使得双耳隐约可见，仿佛一个灵动的仙子落入凡尘。
只是那双星眸却是暗淡无光，只是低头望着怀中包的严严实实的棉布包裹。定睛一看，包裹内貌似一个婴孩，想必昨日的啼哭便是这孩子所发出，而那少女仿佛未觉察到众人，只是愣愣的站在门前，就像她周围的时间静止了一般。
那明白了缘由的妇人转身看见自家男人正目不转睛的盯着那位少女，不由得心生恼意，一把拧住了那男人的耳朵，大声呵斥道“你个死老头子，我看你是着了道了，没准这女人是妖精变得，给我滚回家去！”此言一出其他人也是面面相觊，感觉自己耳根也被拧了个跟头，赶紧拿上工具，灰溜溜的回家了。
也是因为妇人们的嫉妒成见，慢慢的就把村子里的人灌输了一种观念，这母子俩是异类。
而这母子俩却也常年闭门不出，也没什么特殊之处，这倒是让村子里的人放宽了心，又慢慢的恢复了村子往日的生机。
只是村民离他们的房屋躲的远远的，虽然偶尔的接触觉得其与常人无异，却心里都有所忌惮，每每打个招呼便慌忙逃窜。
只是村长比众人要热情的多，经常给这对母子送去食物。而那个襁褓中的婴孩就在这个小村庄里慢慢的长大了。他，便是乌凡，到了这个年岁，正是贪玩的时候，可是村里的孩子见了他也是受了父母的影响，与他在一起的回家便是一顿训斥，久而久之便根本不敢和他玩耍，乌凡却浑不在意。

自己孤身一人玩耍时，甚是喜欢听那郎朗的读书声，还有那经常在村口讲故事的吴昊。而吴昊也不像其他人对待乌凡一般疏远，反而对这个安静的孩童是很喜欢。
虽然吴昊父母也是阻拦，甚至抄起扫帚就要打他，吴昊却是不当回事，总觉得乌凡和自己有缘分。
但其实也就是乌凡打心里相信那他自己都不相信的鬼话，又觉得乌凡颇为可爱，一而再再而三的接触，也就慢慢成为朋友，偶尔还自称吴昊真人与乌凡切磋。
虽然是与一个几岁的孩子切磋，吴昊却觉得乌凡的力气却和自己不相上下，而自己怎么说也是个十几岁的大孩子了，为了能进入那些传说中的门派，天天也对身体进行一些锤炼，虽然每次都能略胜一筹，但也赢得连连抱怨。
再说乌凡也因为有了个朋友，每次回家便都与娘亲诉说每天的事情。只有此时这女子脸上才会有一抹微笑，也稍稍欣慰了些。而每次听完吴昊的鬼话，回到家也会缠着娘亲，让娘亲给他讲故事，却每次听不完就呼呼的睡去。
每当乌凡睡觉之时，女子也会解下那绛紫色的香囊，放在乌凡枕边，感受到娘亲香气的乌凡，便睡的更加香甜。
秋季这凉爽舒适的季节感觉十分短暂，寒冷的冬天便悄无声息的降临了，人们的穿着也变得十分笨拙，此时的乌凡烤着火炉，虽然感觉不是很冷，但那干燥的空气还是让他很不舒服。
而那女子的的衣着却和往日一样的单薄，乌凡皱着鼻子问到：“娘，你不冷吗？”女子却是淡然一笑，点了点头就当是回答了。
乌凡不禁嘀咕道：“娘你好厉害，我要穿那么少岂不是要冻坏了？”毕竟是年幼的乌凡，转眼就忘了这茬，看见外面飞舞的雪花，就欢快的出去堆雪人了。
外面纷飞的雪花洋洋洒洒，季节还是同样的季节，而那些过往，仿佛就在昨天，却再也不会重现。四季交替仍四季，物是人非是非人；堂前春燕拾旧木，不见小僧敲空门。
冬日的季节虽然恬静，却让人感觉枯燥寂静，家家户户的大人们冻的整日蜷缩在屋子里，只是村子中偶尔会有孩童的嬉戏声，日复一日下恍然就迎来了第二年的春天。
积雪消融，万物都涌现了生机，家家户户也都开始敞开房门，舒缓那憋闷了好久的身体。而这日清晨，村子里炊烟刚刚升起，就听见窗外传来了破空之声，村民们便纷纷打开房门，走到院子里四处观望，而当看见来者时，所有人都从内心涌出一种崇拜，敬仰，狂喜之情。
天空之上，只见一个颜色翠绿、约莫两丈见方的一个瓢状的物体载着几个身影。定睛望去，只见两个大概二十几岁的青年，穿着打扮十分的超凡脱俗。
身着一袭白袍，白袍之上皆有如游龙一般的苍翠花纹盘于周身之上，而胸襟上有一个宛若葫芦形状的绿色图案，细看却又像是一个玉字，二人皆是左手握拳放于腰后，而右手捏着剑指放于腹前。
他们的神情十分傲气，而眼神却恭敬的望向前方一位老者。那老者身高八尺，体态端正大方，一身白袍与那些年轻人无异，只是胸前的图案貌似有些不同。
他银鬓白眉，胡须却是老长，感觉年龄颇大，而却满面红光，双目炯炯有神，目光慈祥却透着一股威严，让人心生敬畏。此人便是那玉壶宗专门负责招收弟子的云浪真人。
那云浪真人右手一挥，只见天空绿光一闪，这三个身影便缓缓的落于地面之上。而那瓢状的物体却仿佛泄了气一般，越来越小，竟化为一个葫芦形的玉佩，落入真人手中。
这番奇景，让村民们每次都惊诧万分。云浪真人望着周围密密麻麻的人群，微微一笑，便开口道：“想必大家都记得每五年的例行吸收新血之事。
你们卧溪村虽然地处深山之中，却也是人杰地灵，希望这次还能给我们带来惊喜。闲话少说，让年龄在十至十五岁的孩童，都聚集到村口，由我进行入门资质测试。只有身体强健，头脑聪慧的才能符合要求。通过测试的孩童回去准备好行李，明日午时出发前往玉壶宗进行入门仪式。”
此言一出，气氛顿时变得热烈起来，家家户户有符合条件的孩子，都打扮的干干净净的，只是一盏茶的时间，就都汇集到了村口，而乌凡头一次见到这么热闹的场面，也挤入人群中，兴致勃勃的看了起来。
content_en:
The next morning, smoke rose from the roofs of every house. Housewives were busy preparing breakfast for the family at the stove. After hastily finishing the simple meal, it was time for the "Morning Chat around the Creek" where the women in Woxi Village gathered in twos and threes to do laundry by the stream. Every time we chatted, we inevitably mentioned what happened five years ago. We did this every day but never tired of it.
Five years ago, in the twelfth lunar month of winter, Woxi Village.
Rural life in winter is more peaceful than in previous seasons. No cicadas chirping, no sowing, no labor, no harvest. As usual, children were playing in the snow during the day, and adults were at home feeding poultry and smoking pipes. The day was compressed by the cold, and the sun couldn't wait to fall as soon as it rose.
Because of the cold, every household got into bed early. Maybe it was because the sun had just hidden, or maybe it was midnight, but the villagers invariably heard rustling sounds coming from the wasteland that was once a cemetery not far from the village. The villagers who were superstitious about cows, ghosts, and snakes were all like ostriches. They tied their heads in quilts, closed their eyes tightly, and looked at their noses, but they couldn't breathe. They let themselves go like this, and they didn't know whether they were fast asleep or fainting due to lack of oxygen.
Some brave people peeked through the cracks in the doors and windows. In the white village covered by the cold, only the wasteland was particularly conspicuously glowing with a sticky red light. There was a sweet smell in the air, maybe it was the smell of red light, maybe it was nervousness that kicked over the urine bucket.
A few black, maybe dark red shadows are vaguely visible in the wasteland. His footwork was like a ghost, erratic. Wherever they went, the soil surged and branches flew. When everything calmed down, a house appeared on the wasteland, but these figures seemed to disappear out of thin air.
It was not until noon the next day that the chickens in the village crow slightly. At this time when the yang energy is at its strongest, every household bravely goes to the wasteland to find out what is going on. The villagers were stunned by the houses that appeared out of thin air in the wasteland. The snow around the house was flat and there were no traces of trampling.
People wanted to get closer to see the details, but found a black knife stuck in front of the house door. No one dared to take a step closer. Today's courage was a little weak as the Yang Qi declined, so they had no choice but to give up and returned home in shock. The rustling sound was still the same that night, and the same the next night. It was noon again on the third day, and every household boldly went out to investigate, and found that the house had been slightly repaired, and it seemed that some trivial things had been added to it. But the snow is still flat and the black knife is still standing. This made the villagers of Woxi Village thrilling, but also inexplicable.
One night, the disturbing sound disappeared and was replaced by the sound of hunting wind. And through the crack in the door, I could see that the speed of those black shadows became extremely fast, with a trace of white mixed in between, as if there was something urgent. And just when the son and the ugly changed, the wasteland suddenly became quiet. The villagers held their breath nervously because they thought their heartbeats were too noisy.
After relaxing for a moment, and just when my mood returned to calm, I heard a baby crying outside the window, which was particularly harsh in this cold winter night, as if this was the only sound left in the whole world.
After only half a stick of incense, it finally returned to calm. However, the villagers who had experienced ups and downs in mood were unable to fall asleep. They huddled in their beds, shivering, and stared at the dark night outside the window. They all felt that the period before dawn was very torturous.
The sky had just turned white, and people in every household seemed to no longer want to suffer this kind of suffering. The brave ones decided to fight to the death no matter what monsters and monsters were, leaving their wives and children to pick up the guy one after another and rush out of the house, roaring and roaring fiercely. After a moment, there was suddenly no sound, and the hearts of the family members were all in their throats.
A stickThe time for the incense has passed, the time for the two sticks of incense has passed, some women who could not bear it rushed out the door and ran towards the wasteland, only to find that the men seemed to be possessed by evil spirits, dropping their tools one after another and surrounding the house in a daze.
The woman looked aside from the crowd and saw a young girl standing in front of the house. She was about 20 years old, with willow eyebrows and clear eyes, white teeth and starry eyes. Her skin was like gelatin. If it was pink, it would be too white, if it was too red, it would be too red. She was dressed in white clothes and had a purple sachet hanging on her waist. Her black hair was tied into a bun with a blue hairpin inserted diagonally on it. Some broken hair just made her ears vaguely visible, like a smart fairy falling into the mortal world.
But those starry eyes were dim, just looking down at the tight cotton package in his arms. After taking a closer look, the package looked like a baby. The cry yesterday must have been from this child, but the girl seemed unaware of the crowd and just stood in front of the door blankly, as if time had stopped around her.
The woman who understood the reason turned around and saw her man staring at the girl intently. She couldn't help but feel annoyed. She pinched the man's ear and yelled, "You old man, I think you've got it. Maybe this woman is a temptress, so get out of here and go home!" As soon as this was said, the others looked at each other in disbelief. They felt like their ears had been twisted. They quickly picked up their tools and went home in despair.
It was also because of the women's jealousy and prejudice that the people in the village were slowly indoctrinated into the idea that the mother and son were aliens.
However, the mother and son stayed behind closed doors all year round, and there was nothing special about them. This made the people in the village relax, and slowly restored the village's former vitality.
It's just that the villagers hide far away from their houses. Although they feel like ordinary people when they come into contact occasionally, they are afraid of them and run away in a hurry every time they say hello.
It's just that the village chief is much more enthusiastic than everyone else and often brings food to the mother and son. And the swaddled baby slowly grew up in this small village. He was Wu Fan. At this age, it was time for playfulness. However, the children in the village were also influenced by their parents when they saw him. Those who were with him were scolded when they came home. As time went by, they did not dare to play with him at all, but Wu Fan didn't care.
When I was playing alone, I really liked listening to the sound of Lang Lang reading and Wu Hao who often told stories at the entrance of the village. And Wu Hao was not as alienated as others towards Wu Fan. Instead, he liked this quiet child very much.
Although Wu Hao's parents also stopped him and even picked up a broom to beat him, Wu Hao didn't take it seriously and always felt that Wu Fan was destined to him.
But in fact, Wu Fan believed in the lies that he himself did not believe, and he also thought Wu Fan was quite cute. After repeated contact, he gradually became friends, and occasionally even claimed to be Master Wu Hao to compete with Wu Fan.
Although he was competing with a child of several years old, Wu Hao felt that Wu Fan's strength was on par with his own, and he was already a teenager. In order to enter those legendary sects, he trained his body every day. Although he was slightly better every time, he also received constant complaints.
Besides, because Wu Fan had a friend, he would tell his mother about everyday things every time he went home. Only at this moment did the woman have a smile on her face, and she felt a little relieved. And every time after listening to Wu Hao's nonsense, he would pester his mother when he got home and ask her to tell him stories, but he would fall asleep every time he couldn't finish listening.
Whenever Wufan was sleeping, the woman would take off the purple sachet and put it on Wufan's pillow. Wufan would sleep more soundly when he felt his mother's fragrance.
The cool and comfortable season of autumn feels very short. The cold winter has come quietly, and people's clothing has also changed.Very clumsily, Wu Fan was heating the stove at this time. Although it didn't feel very cold, the dry air still made him very uncomfortable.
But the woman's clothes were as thin as before. Wu Fan wrinkled his nose and asked, "Mom, aren't you cold?" The woman smiled lightly and nodded as an answer.
Wu Fan couldn't help but murmured: "Mom, you are so awesome. If I have to wear so little, won't I be freezing?" After all, Wu Fan was a young man. He forgot about this in the blink of an eye. When he saw the snowflakes flying outside, he happily went out to build a snowman.
Snowflakes are flying outside, and the season is still the same, but those past events, as if they were just yesterday, will never happen again. The four seasons are still changing, things are right and people are not right and wrong; spring swallows are picking up old wood in front of the hall, but there is no young monk knocking on the empty door.
Although the winter season is quiet, it makes people feel boring and quiet. The adults in every household huddle in their houses all day long due to the cold. Only the occasional sound of children playing in the village makes it seem like the second spring is ushering in day after day.
The snow melted, everything was full of life, and every household began to open the door to relieve the body that had been depressed for a long time. But in the early morning of this day, as soon as the smoke rose in the village, they heard the sound of breaking through the window. The villagers opened their doors one after another, walked to the yard and looked around. When they saw the person coming, everyone felt a kind of worship, admiration and ecstasy from their hearts.
In the sky, I saw a scoop-shaped object about two feet square, emerald green, carrying several figures. Looking closely, I saw two young men in their twenties, dressed in very otherworldly ways.
Wearing a white robe, there are green patterns like swimming dragons on the white robe all over the body, and there is a green pattern like a gourd on the chest, which looks like a jade character if you look closely. Both of them hold a fist with their left hand on the back of their waist, and hold a sword finger in front of their abdomen with their right hand.
Their expressions were very arrogant, but their eyes looked respectfully at an old man in front of them. The old man was eight feet tall, with an upright and generous posture. His white robe was no different from that of the young people, except that the pattern on his chest seemed a little different.
He has silver temples, white eyebrows, and a long beard. He feels quite old, but his face is red, his eyes are bright, and his eyes are kind but exuding a sense of majesty, which makes people feel awe. This person is Master Yunlang of the Yuhu Sect who is responsible for recruiting disciples.
Master Yunlang waved his right hand, and saw a flash of green light in the sky, and the three figures slowly landed on the ground. But the scoop-shaped object seemed to be deflated, getting smaller and smaller, and turned into a gourd-shaped jade pendant, which fell into the hands of the real person.
This wonderful sight makes the villagers amazed every time. Master Yunlang looked at the dense crowd around him, smiled slightly, and said, "I believe everyone remembers the routine of absorbing new blood every five years.
Although your Woxi Village is located deep in the mountains, it also has outstanding people. I hope it can bring us surprises this time. Without further ado, let the children aged ten to fifteen years old gather at the entrance of the village for me to conduct the entrance qualification test. Only those with strong bodies and smart minds can meet the requirements.
